title: EMIR 3 Active Account Requirement Checker
description: Determines whether a counterparty is in scope of the EMIR Article 7a Active Account Requirement, classifies the active-account and representativeness (EUR 6bn threshold, five-trades-per-subcategory) obligations, and checks a reporting submission against the RTS Article 10 window. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

notionalVolume.description: Notional clearing volume outstanding, EUR millions

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_emir3_active_account_requirement
mcp_tool_definition.description: Determines an EU counterparty's EMIR Article 7a Active Account Requirement posture: in-scope gate (EUR/PLN IRD, EUR STIR clearing-threshold exceedance), the active-account obligation (Art 7a(1)), the EUR 6 billion representativeness threshold and five-cleared-trades-per-subcategory annual-average test (Art 7a(4)), and the RTS Article 10 reporting deadline (last day of January/July). Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/635-emir3-active-account-requirement-checker.html for interactive use.
